retention: entire IST trading session; archive previous sessions
storage: durable shared ledger, not Streamlit session state
dedup: one visible contract row with separate strategy and trade histories; requalification updates existing row, never silently resets levels

rules.missing_scan: DATA STALE; never infer filter failure from missing data
rules.filter_failure: retain row and levels; no automatic exit
rules.terminal: retain exit price and result; never reopen same trade
rules.new_trade: new signal ID only after cooldown and independent qualification; retain prior trade history
rules.refresh: merge updates, never replace ledger with current qualifying subset
rules.pnl: live bid based indicative PnL for active paper trades; realized simulated result fixed on exit
rules.archive: retain all qualified and rejected records, including first and last qualification timestamps
